name: Mosaic
visualIdentity: A recognizable image built from glass, stone, or gold-leaf tesserae, with coherent shapes, visible gaps, and controlled reflections. Highlights should not overwhelm the image. Suggested palette tokens are optional, not canonical.
suitableUses: Explicitly suited to mosaic artwork with staged tile movement. Inferred fit: title cards, product or editorial introductions, explanatory narratives, and interactive HTML stories when tesserae support the subject. Chaptered storytelling works when it clarifies progression.
limitations: Tile structure, reflections, and Blender rendering can be costly; use the style alone for most work. Avoid simultaneous sparkle, incoherent shapes, excessive highlights, and imprecise tile returns. Chapter transitions may obscure causality or violate continuous-shot and loop needs. Palette suggestions yield to task colors, brand colors, approved references, semantic roles, and source asset colors.
palette: Optional new-artwork tokens: background #E4D8BE; foreground #39494B; accent_1 #47777B; accent_2 #9B694C; accent_3 #B19A61. Keep these discrete; gradients are disabled. Background and foreground are layout roles, not instructions to recolor tiles. Suggested text pair background/foreground has 6.67 contrast; accent pairings listed fail the normal-text 4.5 target. Verify actual compositing. Preserve exact supplied colors and approved role assignments.
motionAndInteraction: Animate selected tesserae flipping or rotating, then returning precisely to stored target transforms. Stage movement and highlights by region. For video, derive state from seekable composition time; use deterministic or baked motion and verify direct, backward, and out-of-order seeks. Interactive HTML may use finite scroll progress for chapter handoffs or story steps; restore states on reverse scroll. Include keyboard, touch, skip, pause, and reduced-motion behavior as appropriate. A prerendered hero loop with static reduced-motion frame and live HTML title is a suggested hybrid.
audio: No fixed soundtrack is specified. Choose music, voiceover, effects, ambience, or silence for the topic and audience; restrained accents may support tile actions or transitions. Honor supplied audio requirements, keep speech clear, avoid clipping, and synchronize and inspect the final mix.
assetRequirements: Create tile meshes and glass or gold materials in Blender using bpy; Cycles is suggested for path-traced rendering, with EEVEE as a faster option. Store target transforms for accurate returns. Delaunator may provide 2D triangle connectivity only; it does not create arbitrary tessera shapes, material reflections, or boundary-aware meshes. Source or create authorized audio and other assets; exact copy and input assets are unspecified.
combinations: Usually use Mosaic alone. Suggested Art Deco pairing adds axial symmetry and ornamental borders; keep gold as accent_3, tile size consistent, and highlights localized. Suggested style-098 portal pairing zooms through a tessera containing the next image, with matching material and continuous motion. Avoid simultaneous sparkle, smooth metallic gradients, and black-and-ivory Deco colors. These are suggestions, not requirements.
productionApproach: Choose Blender/bpy for visual construction and motion; the composition pipeline owns timing, synchronization, validation, and export. HyperFrames is primary; use Remotion only if unavailable or a verified required capability is blocked, recording why. GSAP can provide a paused seekable timeline. Interactive scroll is for HTML only; video must remain input-independent. Build representative frames, inspect the decoded sequence and audio, then deliver source/project, contact sheet, parameters, and reproducible instructions.
